# cmark-gfm (vendored)

GitHub's fork of the CommonMark reference parser, with the GFM extensions
(tables, strikethrough, autolinks, task lists, tag filter) and footnotes.

- Upstream: https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm
- Version: 0.29.0.gfm.13 (tag `0.29.0.gfm.13`, commit 587a12b)
- License: see `LICENSE` (BSD-2-Clause and others, as upstream `COPYING`)

It is compiled into `libObjcMarkdown` (see `ObjcMarkdown/GNUmakefile`) because
MSYS2 has no cmark-gfm package for the Windows build. Build with
`-DCMARK_GFM_STATIC_DEFINE` so the export macros stay empty; GNUstep links
Windows DLLs with `--export-all-symbols`, which makes the functions available
to the viewer.

## Layout
- `src/`: upstream `src/` without `main.c` (the command-line tool) and without
  the re2c inputs (`*.re`); the generated `scanners.c` is upstream's.
- `extensions/`: upstream `extensions/` without the `.re` input.
- Generated by upstream's CMake configure step (Linux, clang), copied verbatim:
  `src/config.h`, `src/cmark-gfm_export.h`, `src/cmark-gfm_version.h`.

## Updating
Clone the new tag, run `cmake -S . -B build -DCMARK_TESTS=OFF`, then copy the
same files over and refresh the three generated headers from `build/src/`.

## `compat/cmark.h`
ObjcMarkdown's own shim, not upstream: it makes `#include <cmark.h>` resolve to
the vendored `cmark-gfm.h` rather than a system libcmark header, whose node type
numbers differ.
